profile.name: Koushikk M
profile.intro: I am a Mechanical Engineer with a strong passion for design, innovation, and practical problem-solving. My academic journey has been a great roller coaster of emotions filled with knowledge and gratitude.

about.summary: I would always like to extend my knowledge and experience in mechanical engineering, particularly in areas related to NDT's, Automotive Design and Sustainable Technologies. With hands-on experience in structural testing, strain gauge analysis, and CAD design, I combine academic excellence with practical engineering skills.
highlights: Internship experience at A.E Engineering Madurai in welding, quality checks, and root card maintenance
Structural testing intern at ATALON using Dewesoft, FlexLogger, and LabVIEW
Strain gauge testing for NIOT (MATSYA-6000) and TEREX India (FRANNA 25T Cranes)
Vibrational testing for BS & B Systems – Sanmar Ltd and Zentron Labs Pvt Ltd
